comment: Render-cost ceilings for scripts/perf-gate.mjs (plan §0a). Every number here is a ceiling the SwiftShader probe
(scripts/perf-probe.mjs, 1280×720, 90 frames per mode) must stay under; the per-area allocations of a phase must
fit below warnAt × budget so the sum has headroom. Formulas, per tier/mode row of the .perf JSON:
calls / triangles (mean over the sampled frames): FAIL when mean > budget × (1 + band); WARN when mean > budget × warnAt.
calls / triangles (max over the sampled frames): FAIL when max > budget × maxRatio, where maxRatio =
max(1.6, baselineMax / baselineMean × 1.1) computed per tier/mode from the reference runs (the baseline named above
and .perf/before-phase2-2026-09-05T06-21-03-274Z.json, taking the larger — tv/heli swing 2–3× between frames).
setupMs: WARN when > budget; FAIL when > budget × (1 + band.setupMs) = 1.5 × budget.
loadMs: WARN when > budget, never FAIL (dev-server dependent).
programs: the MAX over the tier's mode walk (the first sampled row of a tier is skipped — it is taken before the
shader compiles of the later modes finish) must be ≤ the tier's programs budget (FAIL above, no band).
errors[] must be empty on every row (FAIL otherwise).
'static' and 'data' are consumed by scripts/audit/scene-cost.mjs (Node, no browser, no asset pack — hence the NoAssets
suffix); measured +10 % since C5 (2026-09-11), so scene-cost runs --strict in pnpm check.
(just under warnAt, so a re-measure of the same scene is 'ok' and growth over ≈ 1 % warns), rounded up (calls to 10,
triangles to 10k, setupMs to 100); maxRatio is the documented formula over after-s2 and after-s. The C0 ceilings
(after-phase6 + headroom) predated the ground partition P3–P6 and the far field: low setupMs is now ≈ 17–19 s under
SwiftShader, of which ≈ 7.0 s is the ground plan and ≈ 7.1 s the ground meshes (README 地面の契約); the S phase's own
synchronous share is < 1 s and the deferred far field is not in setupMs at all. setupMs swings ±15 % with CPU contention
(an e2e run in parallel), which the 1.5× FAIL band absorbs. Draw calls on the high tier are 40–60 % shadow passes
(3 cascades), of which the 22 cars alone are ≈ 250; the S phase adds ≈ 200 in the overview (forest lids, buildings/solar
block merges, car-park speckle, scatter trees) — count per pass/group by wrapping renderer.renderBufferDirect.
Mode keys: 1 overview, 2 heli, 3 chase, 4 onboard, 5 tv; 6 (director) is report-only.

Re-based at the end of the R phase (2026-09-12, baseline after-r6): every tier/mode mean is that run's value +12.5 % (rounded up, calls to 10, triangles to 10k), maxRatio = max(previous, measuredMax / measuredMean × 1.1); programs = the measured max + 4 (high, the road ribbon / foliage / bark / tree impostor / GLB car / facade-normal programs) + 2 (low). The R phase adds the road ribbons (static per 1 km block), the road furniture, the pack trees (per-quadrant mesh entries, cards, mass), hero houses / cars, solar detail and the terrain-side overlays — in the overview ≈ +110 calls and +2 % triangles over after-s2, in the follow modes +10–17 % triangles from the tree meshes inside 110 m.

I7 (2026-09-15): the STATIC budgets are re-based here on the final I-phase tree (see static.*.measuredAt); the BROWSER ceilings below are still the after-r6 ones and the I phase is over them everywhere (the prelim after-i6 probe: high programs 106 = budget, setupMs 29.8 s, chase / onboard triangles max 8.4 / 8.9 M, low programs 63 of 61) — they are re-based in ONE step from a `LABEL=after-i7 pnpm perf` run on this tree, per the plan's formulas (mean × 1.125, maxRatio = max(old, max / mean × 1.1), programs = max + 4 / + 2, setupMs = measured + headroom rounded to 100 ms), with baseline set to that run. Quality.infield's high-tier LOD was cut to propsNearM 90 / figures3dM 60 at I7 for the same reason, so the follow modes must be re-measured, not scaled.

highNoAssets.measuredAt: 2026-09-15 I7 final (scene-cost --tier high, Node, assets null): 4,409,392 tris / 1,008 meshes / 1,105 InstancedMeshes / 1,149 far-field entries measured, every budget = that × 1.10 (triangles rounded up to 10k, counts to 10). The I phase added +737,421 tris / +115 meshes / +371 IM / +158 entries over after-r6 (3,671,971 / 893 / 734 / 991): the pit building v2 and its lane, the paddock, the ops layer (vehicles / pit equipment / figures), the marshal posts and TV towers, the infield ground rows, facilities, ponds and trees, and the cuts' walls / portals / bores / stairs / footbridges.

lowNoAssets.measuredAt: 2026-09-15 I7 final (scene-cost --tier low, Node, assets null): 2,523,288 tris / 770 meshes / 801 InstancedMeshes / 840 far-field entries measured, every budget = that × 1.10 (triangles rounded up to 10k, counts to 10). The I phase added +670,235 tris / +114 meshes / +177 IM / +53 entries over after-r6 (1,853,053 / 656 / 624 / 787) — the same content with one bucket per prop set, no GLB level and no 3D figures.
